549-6798-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-6798-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.
549-6798-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

4785-5078-5741-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-3388.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-3388.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-3388.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4002-4331-4993-7753.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-7753.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-2403-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

240-803-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-4050.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1362-1479-3875.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1169-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4659-7282-7321.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Nimblewright Schematic.
When Nimblewright Schematic enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Construct and the Nimblewright Schematic token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Nimblewright Schematic triggers, creating a 1/1 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

997-1456-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
997-1456-4871-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.

3560-3967-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3560-3967-5972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

803-1445-2060-6413.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
803-1445-2060-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1-2428-5435-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2428-5435-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

2499-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2558-3698-5687-5688.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

864-2511-2639-3254-4871.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2511-2639-3254-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2511-2639-3254-4871.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1283-2544-2751-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
1283-2544-2751-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {3}, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4605-4681-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Preston.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Preston trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

751-913-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Drake creatures.
751-913-2440.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes ability, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Signpost Scarecrow any number of times.
